Frozen return includes the fields when present. Extra unknown JSON keys remain ignored. DELIVERED_TRUTH: validateDeliverSlice never mentions permissionProfile or model; audit deliverMentionsPermissionProfile false, deliverMentionsModel false; run CLI already maps --permission/--model.

D2 — CLI --permission and --model on deliver. USAGE adds [--permission WORKSPACE_EDIT|FULL_AUTO] [--model M] to the deliver line. commandDeliverCli maps permission: options.permission, model: options.model. commandDeliver/runDeliverSlice options: permissionProfile default null meaning "use slice then WORKSPACE_EDIT", model default null meaning "use slice then null". Precedence: CLI option if provided, else slice field, else PermissionProfile.WORKSPACE_EDIT / null. Same pattern as recoveryDir: options.recoveryDir ?? slice.recoveryDir. Unknown --permission is UsageError like commandRun. No extra FULL_AUTO confirmation — run already accepts FULL_AUTO without one.

D3 — Forward into Backend only. All runSupervisedTask and resumeSupervisedTask calls in runDeliverSlice pass permissionProfile and model. QA is unchanged. Import PermissionProfile from tool-adapters.js (already imported there).
